command: set -euo pipefail; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service); echo WINDOWS=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --name '^FranKenstein -- live$' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}'); for n in mund_01_closed_mbp mund_02_breath mund_21_grin_teeth mund_24_bare_teeth mund_30_whistle_strong; do echo ===$n===; find mund_keyframes -maxdepth 2 -type f -path "*$n*" -printf '%p\n' | sort; done
